Container.Name: tescmd
Container.Overview:
tescmd is an MCP (Model Context Protocol) server for Tesla vehicles. It exposes Tesla Fleet API commands as tools that AI agents (Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Open-WebUI, etc.) can invoke to query and control your Tesla vehicle.
Before starting the container, run the setup wizard to authenticate with Tesla: docker run --rm -it --user 99:100 -v /mnt/user/appdata/tescmd:/data ghcr.io/oceanswave/tescmd:latest setup
Then configure either TESCMD_MCP_TOKEN (simple static auth for local/protected access) or TESCMD_MCP_AUTH_USERNAME + TESCMD_MCP_AUTH_PASSWORD (OAuth flow for remote access).
To protect your bearer token and vehicle control tools from observation, route inter-machine traffic through an HTTPS reverse proxy (or encrypted tunnel like Tailscale) rather than plain LAN HTTP.
Container.Requires: Tesla Fleet API credentials (client ID and secret from developer.tesla.com). Run setup wizard before first use.

Config.Name: MCP HTTP Port
Config.Description: Port for the MCP HTTP server. For secure inter-machine access, route through an HTTPS reverse proxy or secure tunnel to avoid exposing bearer tokens on plain HTTP.

Config.Name: App Data
Config.Description: Persistent storage for Tesla tokens, OAuth state, key files, and cache. Must survive container restarts.

Config.Name: Tesla Client ID
Config.Description: Tesla Fleet API OAuth client ID from developer.tesla.com

Config.Name: Tesla Client Secret
Config.Description: Tesla Fleet API OAuth client secret from developer.tesla.com

Config.Name: Tesla VIN
Config.Description: Default vehicle VIN. Avoids specifying VIN for every command. Find it in your Tesla app under Vehicle > About.

Config.Name: MCP Static Token (Recommended)
Config.Description: [RECOMMENDED] Simple static Bearer token for MCP authentication. Must be at least 32 characters. Generate one with: python -c "import secrets; print(secrets.token_hex(32))". Protect inter-machine traffic with HTTPS or Tailscale.

Config.Name: MCP OAuth Username
Config.Description: [OAUTH MODE] Owner username for the interactive OAuth login page. Only needed when using OAuth instead of the static token.

Config.Name: MCP OAuth Password
Config.Description: [OAUTH MODE] Owner password for the interactive OAuth login page (min 16 characters). Only needed when using OAuth instead of the static token.

Config.Name: MCP Public URL
Config.Description: [OAUTH MODE] Canonical HTTPS URL for this server when behind a reverse proxy (e.g. https://mcp.example.com). Required for OAuth with Tailscale or nginx.

Config.Name: Token File Path
Config.Description: Path inside the container where Tesla tokens are stored. Do not change unless you know what you are doing.

Config.Name: Config Directory
Config.Description: tescmd configuration directory inside the container.

Config.Name: Cache Directory
Config.Description: tescmd cache directory inside the container.

Config.Name: Tesla Region
Config.Description: Tesla API region: na (North America), eu (Europe), cn (China)

Config.Name: Bind Host
Config.Description: Internal bind address. Leave as 0.0.0.0 so Unraid can route traffic to the container.

Config.Name: MCP Port (Internal)
Config.Description: Internal port the MCP server listens on. Change only if you also change the port mapping above.
